title: Content Library Still — connected belongings

location.series: Cox Brand Collection — Lindsay Little / Periscope

slide_intent: Use familiar possessions to make a technical service feel part of daily life.
strategic_value: The casually arranged phone, headphones and bag can extend Cox’s lifestyle language beyond portraits.
demonstration: A phone playing music rests on books and a bag beside turquoise headphones, glasses and keys.
practical_value: Build an object scene around a recognizable activity and preserve clear visual access to the device.

content_islands.name: Everyday objects
content_islands.spec: Arrange the bag, books, clothing and accessories diagonally across the right and lower image.

content_islands.name: Music connection
content_islands.spec: Let the turquoise headphone cable curve into the open left side and lead to the phone.
